boundaries.title: Ethical & Professional Agreements
boundaries.description: Designed to protect the autonomy and psychological resources of early-career professionals.

items.question: Who sets the agenda?
items.answer: The coachee (you) retains full agency over the coaching agenda. While sponsors (e.g., family members) may be involved in initial resource alignment, session content remains strictly confidential per ICF standards.

items.question: How is progress measured?
items.answer: Progress is measured through the acquisition of 'data points' (feedback from experiments) rather than just emotional state.

items.question: Handling transition stress?
items.answer: Coaching is not a replacement for clinical mental health support. If stress levels exceed the coaching scope, we will suggest parallel clinical support or a pause in services.

cases.title: Anonymised Case Studies
cases.description: Illustrating professional transition pathways for early-career individuals.

items.title: Evaluating Multi-sector Options
items.context: A graduate facing decision paralysis between three distinct industry pathways.
items.coaching_moves: Developed a weighted decision matrix and prototyped informational interviews to gather objective sector data.
items.shift: Defined a clear selection rationale based on long-term professional value, resulting in a structured 6-month development plan.

items.title: Proactive Stakeholder Management
items.context: An early-career professional seeking to establish regular performance feedback loops.
items.coaching_moves: Practiced output-linked feedback scripts and identified internal support networks for professional growth.
items.shift: Established a recurring feedback rhythm with line management, improving role clarity and performance alignment.

policies: Ethical Confidentiality: Adhering to ICF standards. No disclosure to sponsors without written consent.
Outcome Disclaimer: Outcomes depend on market conditions and individual engagement; we focus on improving decision-making and evidence quality.
Budget Considerations: Phased payment plans are available for recent graduates; please discuss during the initial consultation.

items.a: We coach the logic of professional value translation and co-edit documents in Google Docs. You retain full authorship and ownership of the narrative.

items.q: What if I lack significant professional experience?
items.a: We focus on turning academic projects and volunteer work into objective evidence of skills and outcomes.

items.q: How does this differ from standard career services?
items.a: While standard services may provide templates, coaching helps you build a personal 'evaluation framework' for long-term career autonomy.
